scheme_name: SMILE - Comprehensive Rehabilitation For Welfare Of Transgender Persons – Skill Development And Training
other_conditions: Applicant must hold a valid Transgender Certificate and Identity Card issued by the National Portal for Transgender Persons
Applicant must belong to the transgender community as notified by the Government of India
Applicant must not be receiving benefits from any other Centre/State scheme
Each candidate can undergo training only once and can enroll in only one skill development programme
Passing a psychometric test is mandatory for enrollment
Maintaining at least 80% live attendance is required to receive the stipend and certificate of completion
benefits_summary: Free skill development training with a monthly stipend of Rs 1000 and post‑placement assistance for transgender candidates.
documents_required: Transgender Certificate issued by the National Portal for Transgender Persons
